recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not reintroduce Device.operation.status for FHIR-36208. Any retirement or replacement of legacy unbound device-operationalstatus artifacts should be handled as a separate terminology cleanup issue with explicit canonical compatibility review.
issue_request: FHIR-36208 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested replacing the existing Device OperationalStatus value set with a Device.Operation.status value set containing on, online, paused, offline, off, not-ready, standby, shutdown, defective, and unknown.
initial_application: The request was initially applied by b21bcbf25eac, which added Device operation-status CodeSystem and ValueSet files, and 3560f64f1625, which corrected code anchors. d76dc5b48270 later removed those separate files during operationalState work, and FHIR-37545 commits cd0f210b03fb and 2dd17b8ba4d5 renamed the operationalState/status family into Device.operation/device-operationstatus before later Device redesigns removed that active element shape.
additional_context: Later final decisions changed the modeling target: FHIR-38904 removed Device operation status/statusReason/operator content when DeviceAssociation was introduced; FHIR-32565 moved remaining Device mode/cycle/duration elements to extensions for R6; FHIR-40515 added a DeviceAssociation.operation.status R5 shape that was later superseded; and FHIR-47604 removed the DeviceAssociation operation backbone and moved operational state concepts into associationStatus.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Device and DeviceAssociation active, but parsed current StructureDefinition XML has no active Device.operation, Device.operationalState, Device.mode, Device.cycle, Device.duration, or DeviceAssociation.operation elements. The remaining legacy device-operationalstatus artifacts are unbound by active Device or DeviceAssociation elements.
